author: musho7-dev
subject: Add crash replay clips: last 10 s in slow motion with a cinematic camera
body:
- Records car, wheels, driver and debris poses at 60 per second for the
  last 10 seconds of a run
- WATCH REPLAY on the results screen plays it back: normal speed, then
  25% slow motion for 1.5 s around the crash (or the end), close camera
  that zooms in during slow motion
- Movie look: black bars, blinking REPLAY dot, GRAVITY GARAGE watermark
  so recorded clips advertise the game, Screen Recording tip, Skip
- Terrain is kept 220 m behind the car so the replay has ground
- Saving the clip as a video file needs a ReplayKit plugin (later)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
